            awk 'FNR==1 && NR==1 {print} FNR>1 {print}' {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/c2_M2.bed > {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/M2.bed

            printf "canonical_motif\tk\tcopies\ttrf_purity\tmodel_purity\tmodel\tspecies\tsample\tcount\n" > {ROOT}/results/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/M2_summary.tsv
            awk -F'\t' -v OFS='\t' 'NR>1 {n[$4 OFS $5 OFS $6 OFS $7 OFS $8 OFS $9 OFS $10 OFS $11]++}
                END {for (key in n) print key, n[key]}' {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/M2.bed \
                | sort -k2,2n -k1,1 -k3,3g >> {ROOT}/results/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/M2_summary.tsv

            before=$(awk '{bp += $3 - $2} END {print bp + 0}' {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/bases/c2_M2.bed)
            kept=$(awk 'NR > 1 {bp += $3 - $2} END {print bp + 0}' {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/M2.bed)
            printf "model\tbp_before\tbp_kept\tbp_dropped\tshare_dropped\tspecies\tsample\n" > {ROOT}/results/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/M2_dropped.tsv
            awk -v OFS='\t' -v before=$before -v kept=$kept 'BEGIN {dropped = before - kept
                print "M2", before, kept, dropped, (before > 0 ? dropped / before : 0), "monkey", "s3"}' \
                >> {ROOT}/results/repetitive_dna/monkey/s3/M2_dropped.tsv
